title: epilobium alpinum var. sertulatum
intro: Epilobium alpinum var. sertulatum, commonly known as Alpine Willowherb, is a plant species belonging to the Onagraceae family. It is valued for its traditional use in medicine, primarily due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Willowherb are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and diuretic, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis, fever, and urinary disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
